## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Added/updated a `check(...)` case in `test.js` for the new behavior
- [ ] If a flag was added or changed, updated **all four doc surfaces**: the
      `USAGE` string in `cli.js`, the options table in `README.md`, the man
      page (`man/cssgrep.1`), and the completions (`completions/`)
- [ ] One self-contained feature per commit (code + tests + docs together)
- [ ] Output stays grep-faithful (format, exit codes 0/1/2) where applicable
